what: Whole core (build rm_gp_bypass with gt_bp_ctl, brief 96F1b) in xsim 2026.1 with AMD's real XPM macros, phase 0, 8 orders (results/b96e/core_lat.py reduction of results/b96f1b/core_sim.sh), stand-in transceiver with a behavioural bypass controller. The stand-in has no buffers: the bypass saving cannot appear here and is not claimed. The tick-to-trade means differ from 96F1's 13.37 to 13.38 by 0.0 to 0.1 clock because the order cadence meets the link-up time differently (min 13, max 14 clocks in every run): the datapath is unchanged.
